close-friends.name: Close friends
close-friends.line: I don't have a close friend I can really talk to.

sources.passage: roughly the same proportion of the public that has no close friends (12 percent)
8% of respondents across 22 EU countries say they have no close friends.

close-friends.prevalence: 12 percent of U.S. adults say they have no close friends (Survey Center on American Life); 8% of respondents across 22 EU countries say the same (OECD, as reported by Euronews).

estranged-family.name: Estrangement
estranged-family.line: I'm cut off from someone in my family.

sources.passage: 27% of Americans 18 and older had cut off contact with a family member.
10% reported being estranged from a parent or child, 8% from a sibling and 9% from extended family members.

estranged-family.prevalence: 27% of U.S. adults have cut off contact with a family member; 10% are estranged from a parent or child (Cornell survey).

breakup.name: Breakup
breakup.line: I'm going through a breakup or divorce.

sources.passage: Number of divorces: 672,502 (45 reporting States and D.C.)
Divorce rate: 2.4 per 1,000 population (45 reporting States and D.C.)

breakup.prevalence: 672,502 divorces in a year in 45 reporting states and D.C., a rate of 2.4 per 1,000 people (CDC). Breakups outside marriage are not counted.

trying-for-a-baby.name: Trying for a baby
trying-for-a-baby.line: I've been trying to have a baby and it isn't happening.

sources.passage: Around 17.5% of the adult population – roughly 1 in 6 worldwide – experience infertility

trying-for-a-baby.prevalence: About 17.5% of adults, roughly 1 in 6, experience infertility (WHO).

harassed-online.name: Online harassment
harassed-online.line: I get harassed or threatened online.

sources.passage: 41% of U.S. adults have personally experienced online harassment, and 25% have experienced more severe harassment
Roughly two-thirds of adults under 30 (64%) have experienced any form of the online harassment

harassed-online.prevalence: 41% of U.S. adults have been harassed online and 25% more severely; 64% of adults under 30 (Pew).

single-parent.name: Single parent
single-parent.line: I'm raising my kids on my own.

sources.passage: Almost a quarter of U.S. children under the age of 18 live with one parent and no other adults (23%)

single-parent.prevalence: 23% of U.S. children live with one parent and no other adults (Pew).
